title: Varda hero
description: An engineering-drawing hero over a full-bleed backdrop slot: on desktop a frame inset by the gutter holds a 6×3 grid of square cells in dashed hairlines, a huge bold orange two-line headline in the left half, a lead at the foot of the framed right half and three link cells under it, each with a thin up-right arrow, that fill off-white on hover. The empty backdrop is a navy wash with a faint warm light that drifts over five minutes. Phones: headline in a 260px top row, lead row, three full-width link rows.
notes: made to sit under varda-header: the header's 72px row covers the frame's top (desktop) and its column covers the right third of the 260px top row (phones)
the backdrop drift is a CSS loop, off with reduced motion; pass background for a real photo or video
best on dark themes (orange headline on the page colour)
the headline scales with the frame width; a much wider display face wraps it to more lines
